purpose: Closed-loop diagnostic of reservoir history versus global attenuation and nominal WBC; not a new trained candidate or blind audit
selection: Original office, earlier sustained rod at7s, and stronger ball/negative layout represent original, sustained disturbance and first-impact failure. Include every planned result; do not extrapolate this three-case diagnostic to all layouts.
controls: Same R34 checkpoint, original gates, torque/slew limits, proprio48/action7, first.2s at1.5625us then50us. Reset only the ESN reservoir before each observation, retaining current-input response and output_gain=.5. Observer and task state are not reset.
failure_policy: All five new episodes retained alongside four existing paired references. No refit, no new gain search, no withheld access. Memoryless reset is an inference ablation, not a separately optimized feedforward baseline.
